guides.intro: What a Frost mage presses from level 1 to 60, stage by stage, as the trainer and the talent tree hand you new buttons. Frost levels by slowing the mob, freezing it at your feet, stepping back and hitting it while it cannot reach you. Each stage lists the full priority, so you can jump in at your level.

stages.title: Fireball
stages.change: **Fireball** is your only attack.
press: **Fireball** until the mob is dead.
If it reaches you, keep casting. Nothing hits hard at these levels.
notes: Keep **Frost Armor** and **Arcane Intellect** up at all times, from here to 60.
The fight lab does not simulate these three levels: its Frost rotation starts with **Frostbolt** at 4.

stages.title: Frostbolt replaces Fireball
stages.change: **Frostbolt** replaces Fireball. It slows the mob, so you get more casts before it arrives.
press: **Frostbolt** from as far away as you can, again and again.
Your wand finishes a mob that is almost dead, once you own one.
notes: **Conjure Water** (4): drink between fights instead of waiting for your mana.
Take **Fireball** off your bar. A slowed mob reaches you later, and that is worth more than Fireball's damage.

stages.title: Fire Blast, your instant
stages.change: **Fire Blast** to finish a mob between a tenth and a fifth of its health.
press: **Frostbolt** while the mob walks in, and whenever nothing below applies. Start no new one once the mob is below a fifth of its health.
**Fire Blast** on a mob between a tenth and a fifth of its health. The tuned rules keep it for the finish, not for the moment the mob arrives.
Your wand finishes it.
notes: **Polymorph** (8): when a second mob joins, sheep it, kill the first, then fight the sheep.
**Arcane Missiles** (8) is not part of the Frost rotation. **Conjure Food** (6) saves you buying bread.

stages.title: Frost Nova: the kite begins
stages.change: **Frost Nova** roots the mob at your feet: step back and keep casting. Talent points start.
press: **Frostbolt** from maximum range while the mob walks in.
**Frost Nova** when it reaches you, then step back out of its reach.
**Frostbolt** while it stands rooted. If it reaches you again with **Frost Nova** on cooldown, keep casting.
Below a fifth of its health: **Fire Blast** (not below a tenth) or your wand. No new **Frostbolt**: a long cast on a dying mob is wasted.
notes: **Improved Frostbolt** (12-14, 18-19) takes half a second off every **Frostbolt** cast.
**Frostbite** (15-17) sometimes freezes a mob your chill hits. Treat it as a free **Frost Nova**: step back and cast.
**Arcane Explosion** (14) and **Flamestrike** (16) are for packs. One mob at a time never needs them.

stages.title: Ice Lance into every freeze
stages.change: **Ice Lance** (talent): an instant that deals four times its damage to a frozen mob.
press: **Frostbolt** from maximum range while the mob walks in, and whenever nothing below applies, while the mob has more than a fifth of its health.
**Frost Nova** when it reaches you, then step back out of its reach.
**Ice Lance** the moment the mob is frozen, by **Frost Nova** or by **Frostbite**. It has an 8-second cooldown, so one per freeze.
If the mob reaches you with **Frost Nova** on cooldown, keep casting: the tuned rules save **Fire Blast** for the finish.
Below a fifth of its health: **Fire Blast** (not below a tenth), an **Ice Lance** that will kill, or your wand.
notes: **Evocation** (20) is for between fights: channel it whenever it is ready and you are under 40% mana.
**Blink** (20) and **Mana Shield** (20) are escapes for a pull that goes wrong, not rotation. **Blizzard** (20) is for packs.

stages.title: Counterspell and Shatter
stages.change: **Counterspell** for mobs that cast. **Shatter** makes spells crit far more often on a frozen mob.
press: **Counterspell** a mob that starts casting: it stops standing back and walks to you.
**Frostbolt** from maximum range while the mob walks in, and whenever nothing below applies, while the mob has more than a fifth of its health.
**Frost Nova** when it reaches you, then step back out of its reach.
**Ice Lance** the moment the mob is frozen. One per freeze.
If the mob reaches you with **Frost Nova** on cooldown, keep casting: the tuned rules save **Fire Blast** for the finish.
Below a fifth of its health: **Fire Blast** (not below a tenth), an **Ice Lance** that will kill, or your wand.
notes: **Shatter** (25, 28-29) and **Ice Shards** (24, 26-27) are why the **Ice Lance** into a freeze is your biggest hit from here on.
**Cone of Cold** (26) goes on C for packs. The tuned rotation never casts it on a single mob; kills measured faster without.

stages.title: Fingers of Frost
stages.change: **Fingers of Frost** (talent): a chill can make your next spells hit as if the mob were frozen. **Ice Armor** replaces Frost Armor.
press: **Counterspell** a mob that starts casting.
**Frostbolt** from maximum range while the mob walks in, and whenever nothing below applies, while the mob has more than a fifth of its health.
**Frost Nova** when it reaches you, then step back out of its reach.
**Ice Lance** whenever the mob is frozen or **Fingers of Frost** lights up, as soon as its 8-second cooldown allows.
If the mob reaches you with **Frost Nova** on cooldown, keep casting: the tuned rules save **Fire Blast** for the finish.
Below a fifth of its health: **Fire Blast** (not below a tenth), an **Ice Lance** that will kill, or your wand.
notes: **Ice Armor** (30) replaces **Frost Armor** as your armor spell.
**Arctic Reach** (34-35) lets you pull from farther away: one more **Frostbolt** before the mob arrives.
**Improved Frost Nova** (36-37) brings **Frost Nova** back 4 seconds sooner.

stages.title: The finished rotation
stages.change: Nothing new to press. The remaining points go to Arcane for mana. Buy every new rank.
press: **Counterspell** a mob that starts casting.
**Frostbolt** from maximum range while the mob walks in, and whenever nothing below applies, while the mob has more than a fifth of its health.
**Frost Nova** when it reaches you, then step back out of its reach.
**Ice Lance** whenever the mob is frozen or **Fingers of Frost** lights up, as soon as its 8-second cooldown allows.
If the mob reaches you with **Frost Nova** on cooldown, keep casting: the tuned rules save **Fire Blast** for the finish.
Below a fifth of its health: **Fire Blast** (not below a tenth), an **Ice Lance** that will kill, or your wand.
notes: **Arcane Concentration** (45-49) makes about one cast in ten free, and **Arcane Meditation** (55-57) keeps half your mana regeneration going while you cast.
This build takes neither **Ice Barrier** nor **Cold Snap**. The hand-made Frost build on the spec page has both: **Ice Barrier** before every pull, **Cold Snap** to get a second **Frost Nova**.

between: Drink your conjured water when you are below about 15% of your mana. That is the tuned rule: topping up earlier cost more time in the fight lab than the wand hits it saved.
**Evocation** (from 20) whenever it is ready and you are under 40% mana.
Eat when you are below two thirds of your health. Conjure both food and water yourself.
Visit the trainer every even level. **Frostbolt** alone has eleven ranks.
other: [Arcane-Frost](arcane-frost-by-level.md) is the recommended mage leveling spec in the fight lab. It plays this same loop and adds **Arcane Missiles** whenever **Missile Barrage** lights up.
Pulling packs is a different game: the AoE Frost build on the Frost page gathers about four mobs, freezes them with **Frost Nova** and channels **Blizzard**.

keys.intro: Your two action bars, slot by slot: bar 1 is Q, E, R, F, Mouse 5, Mouse 4, 1, 2, 3, 4, C and the middle mouse button; bar 2 is the same keys with Shift, and Shift+X in the last slot. Keys are for spells you press in a fight and for the things that help you there; buffs, food, drink, conjuring, the mount and the Hearthstone have no key, you click them between fights. A key keeps its job from 1 to 60 and only the spell on it changes, so you never relearn a key. Bold marks what arrives in that stage: drag it onto the slot when you train it. Free slots stay free until something earns them. Setup and macros: the [mage keybinds page](keybinds.md).

slots.role: Your bolt, the key you press most
Control: stop the mob at your feet
The big hit into a freeze
Packs: the cone (the single-target list never casts it)
Finisher, once you own a wand

bars.title: Action bar 2: the same keys with Shift (packs, buffs, travel)

slots.role: Free (Ice Barrier with the hand-made Frost build)
Free (Cold Snap with the hand-made Frost build)
A bad pull: the best healing potion in your bags (one cooldown for every potion)

notes: Level 4 is the one swap on bar 1: **Frostbolt** takes Q and **Fireball** leaves the bar.
Levels 1-9 fight with three keys: Q, Mouse 5 and the middle mouse button. Add a key when its spell arrives.

No key: **Frost Armor** and **Ice Armor**, **Arcane Intellect**, **Conjure Water** and **Conjure Food**, food, drink, the mount and the Hearthstone. Put them on a side bar and click them between fights. The eat-and-drink macro on the keybinds page is a click too.
**Evocation** on 4 is the one between-fights spell with a key: it has a cooldown and a mana rule, so it is a decision, not a chore. Click it instead if you want 4 free.

Key 1 and Shift+Q are for the Arcane-Frost build: **Arcane Missiles** once it has **Missile Barrage** (37 on its page) and the **Presence of Mind** macro at 53. With the Frost build of this page they stay free.
The single-target rotation never casts **Cone of Cold**, **Arcane Explosion** or **Blizzard**. They are there for a pull that brings friends, and **Cone of Cold** on C is the slow for it.

**Evocation** (20) is for between fights: channel it whenever it is ready and you are under 40% mana. **Blizzard** (20) is for packs.

stages.title: Counterspell and Shatter
stages.change: **Counterspell** for mobs that cast. **Shatter** makes spells crit far more often on a frozen mob.
press: **Counterspell** a mob that starts casting: it stops standing back and walks to you.
**Frostbolt** from maximum range while the mob walks in, and whenever nothing below applies.
If the mob would reach you before a **Frostbolt** finishes and **Frost Nova** is ready, wand it until it arrives.
**Frost Nova** when it reaches you, then step back out of its reach. Skip it on a mob that is almost dead.
**Ice Lance** the moment the mob is frozen. One per freeze.
If it reaches you with **Frost Nova** on cooldown, keep casting **Frostbolt**.
Finish with an **Ice Lance** that will kill, or your wand.
stages.if_hurt: Mob on you, **Frost Nova** on cooldown and your health low: **Blink** out of its reach and keep casting; **Mana Shield** if it still hits you.
notes: **Shatter** (25-27) is why the **Ice Lance** into a freeze is your biggest hit from here on. **Frost Channeling** (24, 28-29) makes Frost spells cheaper.
**Cone of Cold** (26) goes on C for packs. The tuned rules never cast it on a single mob.

stages.title: Fingers of Frost
stages.change: **Fingers of Frost** (talent): a chill can make your next 2 spells hit as if the mob were frozen. **Ice Armor** replaces Frost Armor.
press: **Counterspell** a mob that starts casting.
**Frostbolt** from maximum range while the mob walks in, and whenever nothing below applies.
If the mob would reach you before a **Frostbolt** finishes and **Frost Nova** is ready, wand it until it arrives.
**Frost Nova** when it reaches you, then step back out of its reach. Skip it on a mob that is almost dead.
**Ice Lance** whenever the mob is frozen or **Fingers of Frost** lights up, as soon as its 8-second cooldown allows.
If it reaches you with **Frost Nova** on cooldown, keep casting **Frostbolt**.
Finish with an **Ice Lance** that will kill, or your wand.
stages.if_hurt: Mob on you, **Frost Nova** on cooldown and your health low: **Blink** out of its reach and keep casting; **Mana Shield** if it still hits you.
notes: **Ice Armor** (30) replaces **Frost Armor** as your armor spell.
**Wand Specialization** (33-34) makes your wand hits stronger: from 40 the wand finishes a lot of mobs.
**Accelerant** (35-39) shortens **Frostfire Bolt** once you have it at 40; it does nothing for **Frostbolt**.

stages.title: Frostfire Bolt replaces Frostbolt
stages.change: **Frostfire Bolt** replaces Frostbolt: it counts as Frost and Fire, so both trees' talents apply. Below a third of the mob's health, no bolt.
press: **Counterspell** a mob that starts casting.
**Frostfire Bolt** from maximum range while the mob walks in, and whenever nothing below applies, while the mob has more than about a third of its health.
If the mob would reach you before a **Frostfire Bolt** finishes and **Frost Nova** is ready, wand it until it arrives.
**Frost Nova** when it reaches you, then step back out of its reach. Skip it on a mob that is almost dead.
**Ice Lance** whenever the mob is frozen or **Fingers of Frost** lights up, as soon as its 8-second cooldown allows.
If it reaches you with **Frost Nova** on cooldown, keep casting **Frostfire Bolt**.
Below about a third of its health: no bolt. An **Ice Lance** into a freeze or one that will kill, else your wand.
stages.if_hurt: Mob on you, **Frost Nova** on cooldown and your health low: **Blink** out of its reach and keep casting; **Mana Shield** if it still hits you.
notes: **Frostfire Bolt** slows like **Frostbolt**, so its chill still rolls **Frostbite** and **Fingers of Frost**. Take **Frostbolt** off your bar.
The tuned rules keep the bolt for the mob's first two thirds; below that the wand does the rest.

**Ignite** (40-44), **Burning Soul** (45-47), **Master of Elements** (50-52) and **Critical Mass** (56-58) work on **Frostfire Bolt**; **Incineration** (48-49, 53-54, 59) adds crit to **Ice Lance**. **Blast Wave** (55) is for packs: the single-target list never casts it.

between: Drink your conjured water when you are below about 15% of your mana, and eat below 40% of your health. Those are the tuned rules: resting earlier cost more time in the fight lab than it saved.
**Evocation** (from 20) whenever it is ready and you are under 40% mana.
Conjure both food and water yourself.
Visit the trainer every even level: **Frostbolt** to 40, then **Frostfire Bolt** at 50 and 60.
other: The [Frost guide](frost-by-level.md) plays the same loop with **Frostbolt** all the way, and [Arcane-Frost](arcane-frost-by-level.md), the recommended mage leveling spec, adds free **Arcane Missiles**.
Pulling packs is a different game: the AoE Frost build on the Frost page gathers about four mobs, freezes them with **Frost Nova** and channels **Blizzard**.

keys.intro: Your two action bars, slot by slot: bar 1 is Q, E, R, F, Mouse 5, Mouse 4, 1, 2, 3, 4, C and the middle mouse button; bar 2 is the same keys with Shift, and Shift+X in the last slot. Keys are for spells you press in a fight and for the things that help you there; buffs, food, drink, conjuring, the mount and the Hearthstone have no key, you click them between fights. A key keeps its job from 1 to 60 and only the spell on it changes, so you never relearn a key. Bold marks what arrives in that stage: drag it onto the slot when you train it. Free slots stay free until something earns them. Setup: the [mage keybinds page](keybinds.md).

slots.role: Your bolt, the key you press most
Control: stop the mob at your feet
The big hit into a freeze
Thumb reaction: the instant (not in the tuned list)
Free (no Missile Barrage in this build)
Packs: the cone (the single-target list never casts it)
Finisher, once you own a wand

bars.title: Action bar 2: the same keys with Shift (packs, wards, emergencies)

slots.role: Free (no Presence of Mind in this build)
A bad pull: the best healing potion in your bags (one cooldown for every potion)

notes: The [Frost guide](frost-by-level.md)'s keys: Q takes **Frostfire Bolt** at 40, **Blast Wave** goes on Shift+C at 55 for packs, and key 1 and Shift+Q stay free (this build has no **Missile Barrage** and no **Presence of Mind**).
Levels 4 and 40 are the swaps on Q: **Frostbolt** replaces **Fireball**, then **Frostfire Bolt** replaces **Frostbolt**.
**Fire Blast** keeps Mouse 5 as in every mage guide, but the tuned list never presses it. Until **Frost Nova** at 10 you fight with Q and the middle mouse button.

No key: **Frost Armor** and **Ice Armor**, **Arcane Intellect**, **Conjure Water** and **Conjure Food**, food, drink, the mount and the Hearthstone. Put them on a side bar and click them between fights.
**Evocation** on 4 is the one between-fights spell with a key: it has a cooldown and a mana rule, so it is a decision, not a chore. Click it instead if you want 4 free.
The single-target rotation never casts **Cone of Cold**, **Arcane Explosion**, **Blizzard** or **Blast Wave**. They are there for a pull that brings friends.
